learning_objective: 🎯 Capture the energy and grace of dancing figures by drawing beautiful bending poses and joyful movements!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When dancers move, their bodies make beautiful letters! Sometimes their arms stretch like a 'Y', or they curl up like an 'O'. We draw these lines to show movement.
To make a dancer look real, we have to show how they balance on one foot or leap high into the air without falling over!
When people dance, their clothes dance too! We draw curved lines on dresses or shirts to show that the wind and movement are pushing the fabric.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Flying Dancer Sketch!
fun_activity.instructions: Play your favorite energetic song. Watch a friend or family member do a cool dance move, ask them to freeze for 10 seconds, and quickly draw their bent legs and stretching arms!

quick_recap: ⭐ We use sweeping, curved lines to capture the graceful movement of dancers.
⭐ Drawing the way clothes flow helps show the speed of the dance.
⭐ Stick figures can help us easily find the right balance for a dancing pose.
